description: Starts a fix for one post's image or video in this Xyla shop. Xyla first checks the media for a problem on its side, which makes the fix free; otherwise the fix costs credits. Nothing is changed or charged yet. Then call post_fix_status with the audit_id to learn the cost, tell the merchant, and call confirm_post_fix only once they agree.

post_id.description: The ID of the post to fix.

what_to_change.description: What the merchant wants changed, in their words.

name: request_post_fix
title: Ask for a post fix
